description: This Python source file implements a REST API using FastAPI to serve random facts and manage user favorites. It includes endpoints for health checks, retrieving a random fact, listing, adding, and removing favorites, with in-memory storage for demonstration purposes.

classes.name: Fact
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a single fact string with id-like key.

classes.name: FavoriteRequest
classes.description: Payload to add/remove a favorite fact.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint. Returns a simple status indicating the service is healthy.

methods.name: Fact get_random_fact(seed: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Optional seed for deterministic result during tests."))
methods.description: Return a random fact from the in-memory list, with optional seed for deterministic results.

methods.name: List[str] _get_user_favorites(user_id: str)
methods.description: Internal helper to retrieve or initialize a user's favorite list.

methods.name: List[Fact] list_favorites(userId: Optional[str] = Query(default="default", description="User identifier. Defaults to 'default' if omitted."))
methods.description: List favorite facts for the current user (via userId query param).

methods.name: add_favorite(payload: FavoriteRequest, userId: Optional[str] = Query(default="default", description="User identifier. Defaults to 'default' if omitted."))
methods.description: Add a fact to the current user's favorites.

methods.name: remove_favorite(text: str = Query(..., description="Exact fact text to remove"), userId: Optional[str] = Query(default="default", description="User identifier. Defaults to 'default' if omitted."))
methods.description: Remove a fact from the current user's favorites.

methods.name: List[Fact] list_user_favorites(user_id: str = Path(..., description="User identifier path param"))
methods.description: List favorite facts for a user specified by path parameter user_id.
